releases.title: Doraemon
releases.synopsis: Robotic cat Doraemon is sent back in time from the 22nd century to protect 10-year-old Noby, a lazy and uncoordinated boy who is destined to have a tragic future. Doraemon can create secret gadgets from a pocket on his stomach, but they usually cause more bad than good because of Noby's propensity to misuse them.

releases.title: Saturday Night Live
releases.synopsis: A late-night live television sketch comedy and variety show created by Lorne Michaels. The show's comedy sketches, which parody contemporary culture and politics, are performed by a large and varying cast of repertory and newer cast members. Each episode is hosted by a celebrity guest, who usually delivers an opening monologue and performs in sketches with the cast, and features performances by a musical guest.

releases.title: Men on a Mission
releases.synopsis: Male celebs play make-believe as high schoolers, welcoming star transfer students every week and engaging in battles of witty humor and slapstick.

releases.title: Detective Conan
releases.synopsis: The son of a world famous mystery writer, Jimmy Kudo, has achieved his own notoriety by assisting the local police as a student detective. He has always been able to solve the most difficult of criminal cases using his wits and power of reason.

releases.title: Hello Saturday
releases.synopsis:
"Hello, Saturday" is the rebranding of the popular Chinese show "Happy Camp", hosted by He Jiong and with a fixed group of regular celebrity members.

The program showcases the talent of various stars as well as social topics through creative and diverse content and games. It aims to spread positive energy while keeping up with the current trends and leading youth culture.

releases.title: Against the Current
releases.synopsis: Shen Jialan, once a nobleman's granddaughter, falls from grace after her family is falsely accused of treason. Abandoned by her fiancé Lin Jinqi, she is forced to assume a servant's identity in his household. Despite hardships, she refuses to bow to fate. With resilience and wit, she rises above class barriers, wins Lin Jinqi's heart, earns the family's respect, and ultimately clears her family's name.

releases.title: A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality
releases.synopsis: A poor and ordinary boy from a village joins a minor sect in Jiang Hu and becomes an Unofficial Disciple by chance. How will Han Li, a commoner by birth, establish a foothold for himself in his sect? With his mediocre aptitude, he must successfully traverse the treacherous path of cultivation and avoid the notice of those who may do him harm. This is a story of an ordinary mortal who, against all odds, clashes with devilish demons and ancient celestials in order to find his own path towards immortality.

releases.title: The Voice UK
releases.synopsis: Join will.i.am and our other superstar coaches on their mission to find the next big thing for the music business. Alongside Will we have award-winning Jennifer Hudson, Lord of rock Gavin Rossdale and the legend that is Sir Tom Jones - all on the look out for the next big superstar. Will is promising magic, drama and lots of talent - and we can guarantee that this series of The Voice UK will not disappoint! The prize is a life-changing record deal with Polydor Records, one of the industry's most successful labels.

releases.title: America's Test Kitchen
releases.synopsis: America's Test Kitchen is filmed in a real, working test kitchen located just outside of Boston. It is the home of Cook's Illustrated magazine and the Monday-to-Friday destination for more than three dozen test cooks, editors, food scientists, tasters, and cookware specialists.

releases.title: Cook's Country from America's Test Kitchen
releases.synopsis: "Cook's Country from America's Test Kitchen" is a half-hour cooking show distributed to public television stations (reruns airing on Create) in the United States, which are also available in most Canadian markets. The show's hosts are Julia Collin Davison & Bridget Lancaster; the show and the magazine are affiliated, and the magazine's test kitchen facility in Brookline, Massachusetts, is used as a set for the show. Cook's Illustrated's parent company, Boston Common Press, while retaining its corporate name, has marketed its publishing and media activities under the America's Test Kitchen brand beginning in 2004.

releases.title: Prosecuting Evil with Kelly Siegler
releases.synopsis: Prosecuting Evil with Kelly Siegler is a new true-crime series examining the most harrowing homicides and toughest trials in Texas history — all told with Kelly Siegler's unique insight and unparalleled access.As Chief of Special Crimes in the busiest courthouse in the Lone Star state, Kelly Siegler battled to get killers into courtrooms and faced off with their formidable defense attorneys. Alongside the case investigators and victims' families, Kelly draws on her own extensive experience, the prowess of her fellow state prosecutors and the expertise of skillful defense attorneys to go beyond the headlines and reveal how perpetrators were brought to justice: Texas style.

releases.title: Get Jiro
releases.synopsis: Get Jiro is set in a not-too-distant future L.A. where master chefs rule the town and people literally kill for a seat at the best restaurants. A mysterious sushi master named Jiro enters a bloody culinary war and begins to craft his recipe for revenge.

releases.title: NBC Nightly News
releases.synopsis: NBC Nightly News is the most-watched evening newscast in America, providing the very latest on the day's top stories and going beyond the headlines to add context and analysis to the most pressing issues of our time, both at home and abroad. We go to the heart of breaking news stories, introduce you to everyday people caught up in extraordinary events, offer in-depth reporting on health and medicine, cover international news as it unfolds and we profile those who inspire us to do better in our popular Making A Difference reports. The award-winning broadcast carries a legacy that spans more than six decades, beginning in 1948 - when NBC started broadcasting television's first-ever regularly scheduled network evening newscast.

releases.title: Love & Marriage: Huntsville
releases.synopsis: Love & Marriage: Huntsville centers around the lives of three high-powered African-American couples who come together to help the thriving city of Huntsville, Alabama, continue to grow through their joint real estate venture, the Comeback Group. These couples are longtime friends and avid socialites with strong personalities and points of view. As they strive to make this huge undertaking a success, they face the realities of love and marriage. Will they succeed at mixing business with pleasure? Or will their personal quarrels make foes of these longtime friends?

releases.title: Wan Jie Du Zun
releases.synopsis: Lin Feng was gathering his martial soul in the Lin Mansion. He didn't want to. His fiancee Ji Manyao took the opportunity to take his martial soul, and he almost vomited blood and died. At the same time, Lin Feng's spirit entered the land of the burial of the gods. The mysterious woman in the land of the burials told Lin Feng that he could gain enormous martial arts power and knowledge by obliterating the ancient gods buried here.

releases.title: Milk Street Television
releases.synopsis: The world of home cooking is undergoing a revolution with new tastes, flavors, techniques and influences. Christopher Kimball's Milk Street Television wants to change how Americans cook by bringing home a fresher, bolder, simpler way of preparing food. Chris and his test cooks search the world over looking for the best recipes, and finding home cooks who can teach better ways to prepare a meal at home. Chris also shares tips and techniques designed to make home cooking easier, like how to make foolproof egg whites and how to season a carbon steel pan. Back in the kitchen, Chris transforms what the Milk Street Television crew has learned into practical, simple recipes for home cooks everywhere.

releases.title: Africa: Earth's Wild Home
releases.synopsis: Africa: Earth's Wild Home captures four years of unprecedented wildlife encounters across nearly 30 countries, revealing Africa's breathtaking landscapes alongside the frontline conservationists fighting to preserve the continent's wild future.

releases.title: A Tale of the Secret Saint
releases.synopsis: Fia always dreamed of becoming a knight. Born into a family of knights, she's the least talented among them, but she still clutches to her hope and trains with everything she has. When the day comes for her to slay a small demon and prove her worth, she ends up face to face with a dragon instead! A deadly injury makes her life flash before her eyes…and she suddenly remembers her former life, when she was a powerful Saint in a bygone era who defeated the Demon King. That life ended in pain because of who she was, making her fear ever becoming a Saint again. Now that the magic from her previous life has been rekindled, she may become a more powerful knight than she ever dreamed–if only she can survive long enough!

releases.title: ABC World News Now
releases.synopsis: ABC World News Now gives viewers up-to-date information on current events and news from around the world, airing in the overnight hours. Its tone is somewhat lighter than a regular news broadcast, though reports are filed from the usual ABC News correspondents. Weather and pop culture stories round out the reports.

releases.title: Smerconish
releases.synopsis: After serving as an MSNBC contributor and guest-host on the network for four years, TV and radio personality Michael Smerconish believed he was ready to head a show of his own. CNN agreed, and thus was born Smerconish, an hour long Saturday morning program that takes after its host's independent views. Using a topical, conversational format, he aims for the TV show to be an extension of his weekday radio broadcast, with free-flowing topics and the ability to discuss issues that strike a chord with the audience. Along the same lines, he thinks it's important to present the content in an engaging manner, free of my-way-or-the-highway ideology. Smerconish, who has a law degree from the University of Pennsylvania, is also a New York Times' best-selling author.

releases.title: College GameDay
releases.synopsis: College GameDay is an ESPN entertainment show previewing college football games. It first aired in 1987 with Tim Brando as host and Lee Corso and Beano Cook as commentators, giving an overview of college football games, but the show underwent a radical transformation beginning in 1993, and began incorporating live broadcasts. The official name of the show is College GameDay built by The Home Depot. There is a separate radio broadcast, ESPN Radio College GameDay, on ESPN Radio. Today, the only original cast member remaining is Lee Corso. Rece Davis serves as host and Kirk Herbstreit is Corso's counterpart. Starting in 2008, Desmond Howardhas been added to the cast in the show's introduction. Craig James served as an analyst from 1990 to 1995. Erin Andrews joined the GameDay crew as a co-host and contributor in 2010, replaced in 2012 by Samantha Ponder. On September 5, 2015, Rece Davis (also host of the college basketball version of GameDay), replaced Chris Fowler as host of the college football version, which itself started its 29th season on that day.The show is known for its prediction segment that appears on each broadcast. Typically there are three predictors: Corso, Herbstreit, and an invited guest, usually a celebrity, prominent athlete, or radio personality associated with the host university or school for that week. The end of the show always concludes with a catch phrase and prediction from Corso, who subsequently dons the mascot's headgear of the school he predicts to win the game, usually to the ire or excitement of local fans. Beginning with the 2013 season, GameDay airs for three hours on ESPN. Previously, beginning in 2010, the first hour of the show was broadcast on ESPNU at 9am ET, with the 2 remaining hours of the show on ESPN from 10am-noon ET.

releases.title: Soul Land 2: The Unrivaled Tang Sect
releases.synopsis: The Tang Sect in a turbulent world. There is nothing but martial spirit here. Ten thousand years after the founding of the Tang Sect, it is in relative decline. An extremely talented man was born. Can the new Shrek Seven Monsters revive the Tang Sect and bring it back to glory? A soul beast of over one million years old; Electrolux who can pick stars; The new soul utensil system that led to the decline of the Tang Sect... A lot of secrets are to be revealed. Can the secret weapons of the Tang Sect be sharp again? Can the Tang Sect regain its former glory?

releases.title: Mr. Fanboy
releases.synopsis: University student Wan has a fanboy hobby, following and photographing rising star Nine. When Wan gets a casting opportunity for a support role in a Y series his idol will be starring in, he meets Third, a sharp-tongued leading man and Nine's ship partner. The two clash immediately, but when Wan passes his audition, the two are forced to work together. Despite their dislike for one another, after getting to know Third, Wan starts to look at his rival in a different light. He doesn't know what's wrong with him, but he finds himself avoiding the cocky leading man's gaze more and more often. Beyond that, Wan comes to learn that behind the curtain, the industry that looked so splendid isn't all as he'd thought. Even Nine, his own idol, is hiding something shady.

releases.title: Good Morning America: Weekend Edition
releases.synopsis: GMA Weekend expanded to seven days a week in September 2004, providing up-to-the-minute news, weather and topical features from the familiar set of the weekday program located at the crossroads of the world, Times Square. The show's increased focus on lifestyle, leisure and family-oriented topics are suited for the relaxed pace of the weekend, attracting engaged and loyal GMA viewers as they start their days.Co-anchors Dan Harris and Paula Faris bring great energy and vitality to the morning show. In his 11 years at ABC News, Dan has traveled the globe, reporting from Haiti, Pakistan, Afghanistan, Iraq, Ground Zero, South Korea, Israel and the West Bank. His interests range from international affairs and politics to technology and indie music. Former anchor of ABC's World News Now and America This Morning, Paula delivered unforgettable and colorful accounts from the World Cup. Her popular Real Money reports have shown American families how to save thousands of dollars. As the audience on the weekend continues to grow, GMA is now the #1 morning newscast on Saturdays and regularly beats NBC's Today on Sunday mornings.

releases.title: Life, Liberty & Levin
releases.synopsis: Life, Liberty & Levin explores the fundamental values and principles undergirding American society, culture, politics, and current events, and their relevance to the nation's future and everyday lives of citizens.

releases.title: Prue Leith's Cotswold Kitchen
releases.synopsis: Prue Leith opens the doors to her Cotswold Kitchen, sharing cherished recipes, tips, and handy culinary hacks. Joined by her husband John and a cast of special friends, including Sandi Toksvig, Alison Hammond and chef Tommy Banks, each episode is a unique culinary adventure. Beyond the kitchen, Prue celebrates her personal food heroes both locally and beyond.  And husband John gets to grips with a varied mix of country activities on offer in the Cotswolds. The series is a celebration of food, friendship and fun – with easy-to-cook recipes for every occasion.

releases.title: A Winter Sun Wakes the Wind in Spring Hills' Dream
releases.synopsis: At the peak of his career, top celebrity Feng Qinglang escapes to a remote tea mountain, seeking a brief respite from the spotlight. Instead, he meets Xu Changyang, a free-spirited young tea farmer with an untamed soul. One belongs to the dazzling world of fame, the other to the forests and the land. As they grow closer among the mountains and wilderness, love quietly takes root. But the relentless scrutiny of the entertainment industry and the harsh realities of society soon close in, pushing them toward separation time and again. In the end, will they follow the call of their hearts and risk everything for love?

releases.title: Big Noon Kickoff

Radio host Clay Travis serves as a contributor, and 1997 Heisman Trophy winner and former Michigan Wolverines cornerback Charles Woodson will also join the show on select weeks, most notably if Michigan is featured.

Opening with a newsmaker of the week, Gigot usually interviews a guest for the first half of the program, asking questions related to the writings of the guest or a current event of interest to the guest. Following the guest segment, the program becomes a panel discussion of Wall Street Journal editorial writers giving their opinions on the political, economic, and cultural issues of the current week. The final segment labeled Hits and Misses lets the panelists comment on the best and worst stories or events of the week.

releases.title: The Assignment with Antonia Hylton
releases.synopsis: The Assignment with Antonia Hylton will bring Hylton's thoughtful, deeply reported journalism to MS NOW's audience every weekend. Based in New York, The Assignment with Antonia Hylton will serve as destination viewing for the latest political and cultural headlines, informative discussions and fresh insights from top lawmakers and changemakers. Centered around Hylton's award-winning field reporting and rooted in her signature curiosity and accountability, the program will aim to help audiences better understand not only the latest headlines, but also the broader context behind them, while inviting them into a community that engages more deeply.

releases.title: Connect with Jacob Soboroff
releases.synopsis: Connect with Jacob Soboroff will be the network's first Los Angeles-based program. Built around the connection Soboroff has forged with the MS NOW audience for more than a decade, Connect will bring viewers closer to the stories shaping the country. Connect will also bring Soboroff's storied reporting from the ground in Los Angeles and beyond to help connect the dots between what's happening in local communities throughout the country and larger national conversations driving politics, culture, and daily life.

releases.title: The Cruel Tribunal
releases.synopsis: Modern-day lawyer Jiang Xiaobai finds herself transported to the ancient kingdom of Bojie, where she uses her legal expertise to fight for justice on behalf of the powerless. She challenges deeply rooted customs, including the practice of selling wives, and is eventually entrusted with the task of revising the kingdom's laws. Along the way, she and Prince Sizhou go from misunderstandings to an unexpected bond, eventually pledging their lives to one another. But their love is soon caught in the dangerous struggle for power within the imperial court, as rival factions battle for the throne. Caught between love, justice, and political intrigue, Jiang Xiaobai must hold firmly to her principles and stay true to herself.

releases.title: Tokyo Revengers
releases.synopsis: Takemichi Hanagaki is a freelancer that’s reached the absolute pits of despair in his life. He finds out that the only girlfriend he ever had, in middle school, Hinata Tachibana, had been killed by the ruthless Tokyo Manji Gang. The day after hearing about her death, he’s standing on the station platform and ends up being pushed over onto the tracks by a herd of people. He closes his eyes thinking he’s about to die, but when he opens his eyes back up, he somehow had gone back in time 12 years. Now that he’s back living the best days of his life, Takemichi decides to get revenge on his life.

releases.title: Bloomberg The Opening Trade
releases.synopsis: Everything you need to know as markets open across Europe. With analysis you won't find anywhere else, we break down the biggest stories of the day and speak to top guests who have skin in the game. Hosted by Anna Edwards, Guy Johnson and Kriti Gupta.

releases.title: Fox News Live
releases.synopsis: The latest political and socio-economic news and updates from around the world, live.

releases.title: Embers of the Night
releases.synopsis: Gu Qingyu loses her family in a bombing. After face change, she seeks revenge on suspect Lin Jiming—then falls for him.

releases.title: Love Legend
releases.synopsis: Yun Shao, a young woman from a prominent clan, is brutally sacrificed by her own family to a blood jade ritual. After narrowly escaping death, she encounters Pei Zhao, a member of the Fengyi Guard, and the two become bound by fate through a mother-child Gu parasite. To seek justice for the tragic death of Yun Xiang and uncover the truth behind the strange disturbances at the blood jade mine, Yun Shao breaks through societal constraints to join the Fengyi Guard. As the investigation deepens, eerie blood rituals and dark royal secrets surface one after another. Court politics rage, and various factions scheme and clash. Yun Shao and Pei Zhao fight side by side against corruption and evil, holding fast to their principles amid crisis after crisis—searching for truth and a way forward within a maze of love, hate, and mystery.

releases.title: Live Forever
releases.synopsis: The Eternal Covenant tells of Ning Changyue and Song Yiqiu, bound by a profound connection that has stretched across three thousand years. Through endless ages, they have stood by each other, wandering through the mortal world's fleeting ways, becoming each other's only true anchor. As they step into the modern era, they begin to reexamine what eternity really means. In search of where their hearts truly belong, a long-buried past and an intricate, unresolved fate gradually rise to the surface. Facing both the ripples of history and the storms of the present, they must make a final choice—about love, about belonging—completing a conversation with time and with themselves.

releases.title: Bankzitters: Overleven in Het Wild
releases.synopsis: The five members of the Bankzitters are stripped of their everyday luxuries, smartphones, and comforts, and left in an isolated wilderness environment. Working together—or against each other—they must complete physical challenges, forage/cook food, build shelter, and survive outdoors while bringing their signature humor to the extreme situation.

releases.title: Wolven: een spel van list en bedrog
releases.synopsis: Thirteen specialists play a psychological game in a remote village, centered on observation, intuition, and deception. Each player is assigned a role: ten of them become Citizen and three a Wolf. But no one knows the roles. Every glance, remark, and choice is a potential clue. As the first suspicions arise, everyone tries to discover who is telling the truth and who is playing a double game. As night falls, it becomes clear that the game has begun.

releases.title: World Wonder Ring Stardom
releases.synopsis: Stardom World is the VOD network for World Wonder Ring Stardom. WWR Stardom is a Japanese women's promotion started in 2011 featuring matches of many varieties including high speed octane action, long brutal brawls, and even costume battle royals. In 2019, the promotion was acquired by Bushiroad and has since become one of the top wrestling promotions in Japan.

releases.title: The Manager
releases.synopsis: We will get involved in every little detail of the stars’ lives. The managers who work closely with the stars reveal their mundane lives. Once the information is all revealed, the professional meddlers from various different fields are invited to make comments regarding even the smallest details. Lee Yeong Ja, Jun Hyun Moo, Song Eun I, Kim Saeng Min, Yang Se Hyeong and Yoo Byung Jae participate as the life meddlers along with the professionals.

releases.title: The Story Is with Elex Michaelson
releases.synopsis: The Story Is will feature live nightly panels and debates on set featuring a range of voices including attorneys Gloria Allred and Areva Martin, conservative talk radio hosts Larry Elder and Jennifer Horn, progressive podcast host Brian Tyler Cohen, former California GOP chair Jessica Millan Patterson and journalists Peter Hamby from Puck and POLITICO's Melanie Mason.

releases.title: Project XY
releases.synopsis: Using a 'Search for the Leading Actor' format, the show will cast the main and supporting CPs for our company's debut BL drama. It creates a complete business loop across talent-building, drama incubation, fan economy, and merchandise, serving as the launchpad for Chinese-language BL content on the global stage. Six men arrive at a seaside house as complete strangers, each searching for the partner who matches him best.

releases.title: My View with Lara Trump
releases.synopsis: My View with Lara Trump features big picture analysis and interviews with thought leaders, shedding light on the headlines driving the national conversation and affecting families around the country.

releases.title: Farm Busily in the Cold Palace
releases.synopsis: Modern office worker Lu Yunluo wakes up to find herself transported into the body of an abandoned consort banished to the cold palace, where she crosses paths with the newly crowned Emperor Ji Wujue. Hoping to live a quiet, carefree life, she uses her modern knowledge of medicine and farming to make a fortune and gradually earns the favor of the imperial court. Along the way, she unexpectedly finds love.

releases.title: Thunder Chaser
releases.synopsis: As drug trafficking spreads unchecked, narcotics squad captain Bai Hua leads young police officers, including Zhuang Yan and Li Xiao, into perilous missions. They work undercover and pit their wits against drug dealers. Step by step, they unravel the trafficking network, ultimately arrest the kingpin, tear out the corrupt protective umbrella behind him, and keep the border safe.

releases.title: The Masked Lover
releases.synopsis: Warlord Lu Zhentian controls Fancheng. His adjutant, He Jingchen, plots to seize the Lu family's hidden treasure, hoping to strengthen the army and protect the people. Su Yutang, an orphan from an opera troupe, goes undercover to seek revenge. After uncovering He Jingchen's plan, she turns it to her own advantage, throwing the situation into turmoil. When they discover that Lu Zhentian plans to trade the treasure for opium and harm the people, Su Yutang and He Jingchen see through each other's facades and join forces. Together, they lay a trap, seize the treasure, and ultimately set off on a new journey side by side.

releases.title: Spark of the Long March
releases.synopsis: Set in the pivotal period after the Maogong Meeting during the Long March, a time of tangled conflicts, fierce line struggles, and daunting ethnic work, the drama revolves around the dispute between going north and going south. It recreates how the Party Central Committee safeguarded Party-wide and army-wide unity, and depicts the Red Army bringing ethnic minority people together to face strong foes and coexist in harmony amid extreme hardship, showcasing the indestructible power of ethnic unity on the Long March.

releases.title: The Arena: Saturday
releases.synopsis: Kasie Hunt brings key players into the arena for sharp analysis and panel discussion on the week's news in politics and culture.

releases.title: Sins and Roses
releases.synopsis: As a boy, Serhat lost both his father and fortune but built an empire on family and integrity. His world shatters when his wife Berrak hides a devastating secret and falls into a coma. While searching for answers, his heart hardens—until he meets Zeynep, a passionate florist chasing the same truth, igniting a journey of trust, passion, and redemption.

releases.title: Fights Break Sphere
releases.synopsis: In a land where no magic is present. A land where the strong make the rules and weak have to obey. A land filled with alluring treasures and beauty, yet also filled with unforeseen danger. Three years ago, Xiao Yan, who had shown talents none had seen in decades, suddenly lost everything. His powers, his reputation, and his promise to his mother. What sorcery has caused him to lose all of his powers? And why has his fiancee suddenly shown up?

releases.title: КСТАТИ
releases.synopsis: A humorous show from VK Video in the genre of Late Night Show. Popular comedians will discuss current events, news and joke with star guests

releases.title: Jornal Nacional
releases.synopsis: Jornal Nacional is a Brazilian Emmy-winning primetime news program aired by Rede Globo since September 1, 1969. It was the first news program broadcast live by a television network throughout Brazil.

releases.title: Saturday in America
releases.synopsis: Featuring conversations with newsmakers across the political landscape, Saturday in America with Kayleigh McEnany will provide a comprehensive look at the headlines dominating the news cycle.

releases.title: America Right Now
releases.synopsis: Tom Basile tackles the week's biggest stories with top talkers from politics, Hollywood, and across America.

releases.title: Zeri Feisheng
releases.synopsis: In the chaotic times, demons and monsters roam freely, and treacherous officials are in power. With the invasion of the Netherworld, both humans and Netherworld beings wreak havoc on the mortal world, and the wild gods who work for the Netherworld bully the common people. Enraged, Xu Ying, a snake-catcher, rebels and commits the sin of killing a god, and also takes out an incompetent court official. Hunted down by the two realms, his fleeing begins...

releases.title: Ascendance of a Bookworm
releases.synopsis: When a sickly young girl suddenly becomes obsessed with inventing new things, her family and friends are all puzzled. "What has gotten into Myne?" they wondered, never dreaming that the answer is not a "What" but a "Who": Urano Motosu, a book-loving apprentice librarian who died in an earthquake in Tokyo who somehow found herself in Myne's body! And since Myne's world is still in a medieval stage, where books can only be owned by the elite, the new Myne intends to do everything she can to bring her beloved books to the masses in the time she has left.

releases.title: Big City Greens
releases.synopsis: The offbeat adventures of 10-year-old Cricket Green, a mischievous and optimistic country boy who moves to the big city with his wildly out of place family – older sister Tilly, father Bill and Gramma Alice.

releases.title: Squawk Box Europe
releases.synopsis: Squawk Box Europe has everything you need to prepare for the first trade. Steve Sedgwick, Karen Tso and Julianna Tatelbaum speak to CEOs and CFOs from across Europe and the UK to understand the most complex market dynamics. Join the debate, dissemination, and discussion around some of the most market-moving and complex stories of the moment and insights into making you money work around the news.

releases.title: A Fazenda
releases.synopsis:
A Fazenda is the current Brazilian version of the The Farm reality television show based on the Swedish television series of the same name that was originally created in 2001 by Strix and produced in association with Sony Entertainment and Endemol.

The show is based on a group of celebrities living together twenty-four hours a day in a Farm, isolated from the outside world while having all their steps followed by cameras around-the-clock, with no privacy for three months.

The contestants compete for the chance to win the grand prize by avoiding weekly eviction, until the last celebrity remains at the end of the season that can claim the grand prize. The show is presented by news reporter Britto Junior alongside actress Chris Couto and directed by Rodrigo Carelli. Record's website and a Record-owned pay-per-view channel offer round-the-clock coverage.

releases.title: Strictly Come Dancing
releases.synopsis: A dance competition where celebrities compete to be crowned the winner. Who is kicked out of the competition each week is decided by the judges scores and viewer votes. Are today's celebrities fleet of foot or do they have two left feet?

releases.title: Idol
releases.synopsis: The first season of Sweden's Idol premiered in August 2004 and continued until its grand finale on 26 November. It is a spin off of Britain's Pop Idol.

releases.title: All Elite Wrestling: Collision
releases.synopsis: An in-ring show featuring more wrestlers, more stories and more action to super-serve fans.

releases.title: All Elite Wrestling: Collision
releases.synopsis: An in-ring show featuring more wrestlers, more stories and more action to super-serve fans.

releases.title: One Hundred Thousand Years of Qi Refining
releases.synopsis: One hundred thousand years ago, the Heavenly Lan Clan reigned over the cultivation world, and all the disciples of the clan were proud and invincible. In order to break through the cultivation level and ascend as soon as possible, Xu Yang, the only disciple of the sect, had been in the Qi refining stage. When he came out, the cultivation world had already declined and only three or five disciples were left in Tian Lan Clan. As the clan expands, the truth of Xu Yang's stagnant cultivation is revealed step by step, and a hidden secret that runs through the three realms of human, devil and immortal is revealed to everyone! Is it a thought to become a god, or a thought to become a devil? The life and death of the world is between the palms of Xu Yang's hands!

releases.title: Call Me by Fire
releases.synopsis: Call Me by Fire is a music competition reality show by Mango TV, featuring male singers, dancers, actors, and producers. Through mutual challenge and collaboration, they define the spirit of "a burning life that always shines."

releases.title: TMZ
releases.synopsis: Based on the popular gossip website, this entertainment newsmagazine delivers daily updates on Hollywood's rich, beautiful and screwed-up. The program often shows highlights of the day's staff meeting during which reporters pitch ideas for stories to air that day.

releases.title: Fox & Friends Weekend
releases.synopsis: Early risers get a chance to experience their own news, information and entertainment that "FOX and Friends" viewers get during the week with this weekend version of the show. In addition to reporting and discussion of the latest news, the show features weather forecasts to help viewers plan their weekend activities.

releases.title: Weather Command Weekend
releases.synopsis: Stay up to date inside the Weather Command center with a weekend forecast and real-time alerts.

releases.title: Kyunki Saas Bhi Kabhi Bahu Thi
releases.synopsis: A mother-in-law's struggle to put up with her three bahu's. The three bahu's have grown up sons. The bahu's sons start to get involved with having girlfriends and the bahu's try and break their relationships up.

releases.title: Pushpa Impossible
releases.synopsis: Pushpa Impossible is the story about a feisty middle-aged woman having studied until grade 9 in a Gujarati medium school and going back to school at the age of 44! She is boisterous, uncouth, impulsive, hardworking and an endearingly loveable mother of three children. She is Pushpa Patel hailing from a small town Patan in Gujarat and now residing at Bapodra Chawl in Mumbai. The show is a peek into her day-to-day struggles, her small victories, her Juggad, her shortcomings, and her constant pursuit of living a good life while struggling as a full-time mother and part-time businesswoman. The show is an autobiography of a mother, who decides to go back to school and change her life by impacting many lives!

releases.title: Tales of Demons and Gods
releases.synopsis: In his past life, although too weak to protect his home when it counted, out of grave determination Nie Li became the strongest Demon Spiritist and stood at the pinnacle of the martial world. However, he lost his life during the battle with the Sage Emperor and six deity-ranked beasts. His soul was then brought back to when he was still 13 years old. Although he's the weakest in his class with the lowest talent, having only a red soul realm and a weak one at that, with the aid of the vast knowledge which he accumulated from his previous life, he decided to train faster than anyone could expect. He also decided to help those who died nobly in his previous life to train faster as well. He aims to protect the city from the coming future of being devastated by demon beasts and the previous fate of ending up destroyed. He aims to protect his lover, friends, family and fellow citizens who died in the beast assault or its aftermath.

releases.title: The D Dorm
releases.synopsis: When Dobby declares his intent to sell the D Dorm, he ends up on a mission to track down the first love of the spirit A Kong in exchange for the right. All the while, he has to deal with the residents trying all sorts of methods to prevent the sale.

releases.title: The Weekend View
releases.synopsis: The Weekend View will focus on the biggest stories in entertainment and the buzziest news topping social media feeds. With all-new "Hot Topics," the co-hosts will give their one-of-a-kind takes with their signature candor and humor. Plus, "The Weekend View" will include "Behind the Table" segments with executive producer Brian Teta and the co-hosts as they dive deeper into pop-culture stories from the week.

releases.title: Teenage Boss: Next Level
releases.synopsis: From deciding what's for dinner to planning family outings (and maybe ven a cheeky splurge), 10 new teens are about to find out what it really takes to run the show. Emma Watkins is back to cheer them on, offer advice and provide the occasional reality check. The teens are not just managing the household budget; they're also saving for their own ambitious goals – from a state-of-the-art drone, to funding a home recording studio or buying their first car. With Emma's guidance they'll face real-life financial challenges teaching both themselves and their parents about money management and independence.

releases.title: Austin City Limits
releases.synopsis: Now the longest-running music series in American television history, ACL showcases popular music legends and innovators from every genre.

releases.title: Чудо
releases.synopsis: The country's most popular blogger‑coach, Mia, knows the most important thing about people — what they really want. The thing they don't even say out loud, even to themselves. Millions of people come to her for change, for meaning, for a miracle. And their lives really do change. But a miracle has a price — and everyone has to decide what they're willing to do for it.

releases.title: Four Hands, Two Sonatas
releases.synopsis: When two young pianists from completely different worlds meet at an elite music high school, the melodies of their lives become intimately intertwined.

releases.title: Anupamaa
releases.synopsis: Anupama had to sacrifice a lot to become an ideal wife, daughter-in-law, and mother. After a bitter realisation, she sets out to live on her own terms.

releases.title: Irreplaceable
releases.synopsis: After witnessing her mother's suicide following a divorce, Xu Chi defies her tragic fate by rising from an ordinary graduate to a sharp-witted top consultant. Drawn into the covert revenge scheme of seasoned partner Ye Xinzhi, who mentors her while navigating their growing mutual attraction, the duo confronts a crossroads when professional upheavals collide with their evolving bond.

releases.title: Khatron Ke Khiladi
releases.synopsis: Twelve celebrity contestants face their worst fears and perform a series of death-defying stunts under the supervision of a host to win the coveted title.

releases.title: Regular Show: The Lost Tapes
releases.synopsis: Familiar duo Mordecai and Rigby navigate mundane park jobs that inevitably spiral into surreal, chaotic disasters.

releases.title: A Love Other Than Yours
releases.synopsis: A realistic, emotionally resonant romance about a couple in their tenth year together whose comfortable relationship is tested by unexpected feelings.

metadata.episode_name: Are We Dreaming the Same Dream?

releases.title: The Alliance
releases.synopsis:
In the show, participants form teams to earn as many points as possible during games and challenges.

Any contestant on the winning team at the end of the month stands a chance of winning €100,000, but there can only be one ultimate winner of this prize; ultimately, they must compete against one another. Participants on the worst-performing team at the end of the month risk being sent home empty-handed. Consequently, two contestants are eliminated each month, but two new faces join the group to replace them.

releases.title: My Little One
releases.synopsis: A documentary reality show exploring modern women’s lives and growth through diverse ages and backgrounds.

releases.title: A Wild Last Boss Appeared!
releases.synopsis: An MMO gamer awakens as the Black-Winged Tyrant, Lufas Maphaahl, rising from her sealed fate—only to find this is very real. Her defeat 200 years ago unleashed monsters of death, and the legend is one of terror. Now, trapped in the body of history's most feared conqueror, he must survive a world that wants her dead…and uncover why he's here.

metadata.episode_name: There Was Something Incredible in My Homeland!

releases.title: America's Test Kitchen From Cook's Illustrated
releases.synopsis: Equipment reviews, taste tests, and recipes from the test kitchen to the home cook. A team of test cooks that viewers have come to love and trust deconstruct recipes and reveal the test kitchen’s secrets to foolproof cooking at home.

releases.title: On Patrol: First Shift
releases.synopsis: Dan Abrams, Sean "Sticks" Larkin and Curtis Wilson discuss what's in store for the upcoming episode of On Patrol: Live and provide a sneak peak of the departments and officers that the cameras will be following. The hosts will also look back at the most memorable moments from past episodes including everything from police pursuits to encounters with unforgettable suspects, as well as inspiring acts of heroism and courage under fire.

releases.title: You Maniac
releases.synopsis: When a carefree playboy meets the one man who refuses to fall for his charm, his competitive ego turns into an obsession he can't resist.

releases.title: Outside
releases.synopsis: Going beyond the four walls, Outside is the latest spin-off from the Sidemen's smash-hit series Inside. A new group of content creators are thrown into the forest to battle for a prize of up to £1 million. With every comfort eating into the prize pot, they'll face brutal decisions, unpredictable challenges and plenty of Sidemen mischief as they fight to keep hold of the cash.

releases.title: Svengoolie
releases.synopsis: The host Svengoolie talks about various horror movies while showing the movies, one per episode, and gives an introduction to them and performs an act during the commercial breaks. One of the constant tropes is that he will ask a question, then cut back to the movie in a way that looks like the character is answering that question. He also does a deep dive on the early careers of the major actors, and also what has happened to them since then.

releases.title: Beyond Time's Gaze
releases.synopsis: Xu Qing lives in a world where the weak are the prey of the strong, and every day is a fight to survive. The aura of a god has polluted the entire world, including the resources necessary to practice cultivation. As a result, cultivators risk mutation and death when they try to become more powerful. Xu Qing’s goals are simple: he wants to survive, and he wants to find his lost family. He lives in brutal, ruthless, and chaotic circumstances, but he encounters good people that become his close friends. He is not crafty and cowardly like Bai Xiaochun. He is not clever and greedy like Meng Hao. He is his own person.

releases.title: The Great Indian Kapil Show
releases.synopsis: Comedian Kapil Sharma hosts this laugh-out-loud variety talk show with celebrity guests, hilarious antics and his signature supporting cast.

releases.title: Dive into You
releases.synopsis: An actress and her twin brother slip through time – and swap bodies – to save their friend's life.

releases.title: Échappées Belles
releases.synopsis: Échappées Belles is a French weekly discovery magazine, broadcast on Saturdays in the first part of the evening on France 5 since September 30, 2006. It is presented in turn by Sophie Jovillard, Jérôme Pitorin, Ismaël Khelifa, Tiga, Sabine Quindou, Théo Curin and Anto Cocagne.

releases.title: X-Faktor
releases.synopsis: X-Faktor is the Hungarian version of The X Factor, a show originating from the United Kingdom. It is a television music talent show contested by aspiring pop singers drawn from public auditions. The show premiered in 2010 and it continues its success nowadays in the eleventh series.

releases.title: On Patrol: Live
releases.synopsis: "On Patrol: Live" follows police officers and sheriff's deputies from diverse agencies in different cities across the country for three hours. Program hosts Dan Abrams, retired Tulsa Police Department Sgt. Sean "Sticks" Larkin and Deputy Sheriff Curtis Wilson provide minute-by-minute perspective and analysis from a central studio location during footage. Local residents from the communities of featured departments are given the opportunity to have a firsthand experience during ride-alongs with officers on live nights.

releases.title: Big Brother
releases.synopsis: Portuguese version of the reality competition which follows a group of HouseGuests living together 24 hours a day in the "Big Brother" house, isolated from the outside world but under constant surveillance with no privacy.

releases.title: Saturday Kitchen Live
releases.synopsis: Saturday Kitchen Live is a 90 minute cookery programme, which is broadcast live on BBC One on Saturday mornings. Matt Tebbutt is the predominant presenter. Andi Oliver and Michel Roux Jr. have also presented several episodes. Previous presenters have included Antony Worrall Thompson and Gregg Wallace. The programme is currently produced by Cactus TV. The programme has also aired on RTÉ One in Ireland on Saturday mornings, the episodes shown are several months old.

metadata.episode_name: Matt Tebbutt, John Chantarasak, Anna Haugh, Vicky McClure, Jonny Owen and Olly Smith

releases.title: Quem Ama Cuida
releases.synopsis: A hardworking physical therapist, Adriana is facing multiple challenges at once. After being fired from the clinic where she works, her house is hit by a flood that ends up killing her husband, Carlos. Now homeless and struggling to support her family, Adriana starts working for the Brandãos, a traditional wealthy family from São Paulo, as the caregiver for Artur, the grumpy patriarch. The millionaire jeweler, known for driving away every employee, gradually forms a genuine bond with Adriana, who must also deal with the distrust of the rest of the family.

releases.title: The Voice of Germany
releases.synopsis: The Voice of Germany is a German reality talent show that premiered on 24 November 2011 on ProSieben and Sat.1. Based on the reality singing competition The Voice of Holland, the series was created by Dutch television producer John de Mol. It is part of an international series.

releases.title: Entertainment Tonight
releases.synopsis: Daily tabloid television news show on entertainment and celebrity news with unprecedented access to Hollywood's biggest stars, exclusive behind-the-scenes looks at upcoming film and television projects, as well as the real story behind Hollywood's latest news.

releases.title: The Eternal Supreme, Li Yunxiao
releases.synopsis:
Once hailed as the third-strongest expert on the Tianwu Continent, Martial Emperor Gu Feiyang found his cultivation trapped at its peak by the very laws of the world. To break through his limits, he orchestrated an audacious plan, sacrificing everything to reincarnate and begin anew.

Reborn as Li Yunxiao, a fifteen-year-old heir of a powerful military family in the Kingdom of Tianshui, he finds himself caught in a storm of invasion, royal succession struggles, and political intrigue. While others fight for power and status, Li Yunxiao sees the bigger picture. Armed with the wisdom and experience of a former Martial Emperor, he calmly overcomes every obstacle on his path toward a single goal: completing the grand design he began in his previous life and laying the foundation for true godhood.

releases.title: Shadow Punisher
releases.synopsis: Lord Qingyang's son, Li Si, devised a plan to infiltrate the Imperial Detective Division to uncover the truth behind the death of the Fourth Prince. There, he met and joined forces with Bai Zhenzhu, the finest female forensic expert in the land; and Meng Rui, a ghost-catcher renowned for his martial prowess but burdened with a deep-seated vendetta. Together, they formed the Divine Detectives. With seamless teamwork and unwavering determination, this trio ventured through perilous challenges, solving eight enigmatic and bizarre cases.

releases.title: A Prophet
releases.synopsis: After his family is wiped out by the Tianxiang Sect, Shangguan Chengming goes undercover to take revenge. With the help of Jiang Feiyan, they use a series of scams to expose corruption and fight for justice.

releases.title: Rise and Fall
releases.synopsis: The story revolves around the host explaining the show where 4 celebrities, of which 2 in the penthouse, are trying to maintain their position as Rulers while 2 in the basement are fighting to Rise to the Penthouse to topple a Ruler.

releases.title: A Polish Family
releases.synopsis: Ludwik and Natalia Boski navigate the chaos of raising three children while also managing their busy careers.

releases.title: 42: The Answer to Almost Everything
releases.synopsis: What would we be without mucus? Can we live on water? How much does life weigh? Finding out the answers is the aim of ARTE's new science show. In a nod to Douglas Adams's "Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy", where the figure 42 is the ultimate answer to all questions, 42 tries to provide the answers.

releases.title: Best Singers
releases.synopsis: In this singing competition reality series, each series a number of well-known performers are picked and in each episode, one singer is centrally focussed and the remaining artists sing songs by that specific artist. The original artist judges the "covers" of his songs done by the participant artists.

releases.title: MTV Hustle
releases.synopsis: MTV Hustle is India's first rap reality show. Judged by Raftaar, Nucleya and Raja Kumari, it premiered on 9 August 2019. Hosted by Gaelyn Mendonca, it airs on MTV India.

releases.title: The Voice of Poland
releases.synopsis: The Voice of Poland is a Polish reality talent show that premiered on September 3, 2011 on the TVP 2 television network. The Voice of Poland is part of the international syndication The Voice based on the reality singing competition launched in the Netherlands as The Voice of Holland, created by Dutch television producer John de Mol.

The film is a collaboration between Belfast duo BICEP, visual artist Zak Norman, and filmmaker Charlie Miller. They weave documentary realism, music video aesthetics, and artistic abstraction together with the perspectives of indigenous peoples on the impact of colonialism and industrialization.  The narrative is punctuated by musical vignettes from Inuit and Sami artists (including Greenlandic rapper Tarrak and Sami singer Katarina Barruk), which together form the backbone of BICEP’s score. Meanwhile, specially built cameras capture the Arctic landscapes in surreal, alien colors that reflect a rapidly changing world.

releases.synopsis: An artist’s memoir navigating the scars of his own past through the lens of Thailand’s fractured political history and surreal contemporary art. The film traces nearly four decades of growth—from a boy with a meaningless name to a young man awakening amidst the smoke and blood of history. It is a profound exploration of grief, intertwining personal loss with the death of an internal patriarch, the cost of freedom, and the lingering aesthetics of the soul.

releases.title: Princess of the Murder
releases.synopsis: Princess of the Murder is a campy, self-aware horror comedy that blends outrageous humor with over-the-top scares. It’s a story about cruelty, transformation, and the monstrous side of revenge—all wrapped in a delightfully ridiculous Halloween package. Balancing dark themes with absurd fun, the film delivers both chills and laughs, celebrating the spirit of B-movie horror while offering a tragic yet twistedly empowering tale.

releases.title: While the Green Grass Grows: A Diary in Seven Parts
releases.synopsis: A chronicle of the wonders found in everyday life and events. Tragic and comic, philosophical and poetic, Mettler’s diary combines personal conversations, family history, memories, and love. The film gracefully explores our shared destiny and elevates the diary to the level of visionary cinema. Its meditative approach and investigative gaze create a space to capture the fragility of relationships, where reflections on the human condition and the environment merge in a stream of consciousness. Mettler travels between Switzerland and Canada, visits the mountains of New Mexico, and teaches at a film school in Cuba. He is always accompanied by the camera, “a machine that carries me through time.”

releases.title: Show me From Behind the Wall
releases.synopsis: After several years of distance, Mary Jane agrees to reunite with a group of former friends for a trip meant to offer reconnection and rest. However, the reunion quickly becomes uncomfortable. Old wounds, unresolved conflicts, and buried secrets begin to surface, turning the experience into an increasingly tense and claustrophobic one. Isolated in a house far from the city, the women are forced to confront the past and face the emotional consequences of deep trauma. The film offers a disturbing portrait of the psychological deterioration of a woman pushed to her limits, where sanity dissolves and nothing is exactly as it seems.

releases.title: Dear Debbie
releases.synopsis:
Sometimes, enough is enough…

Debbie Mullen is losing it. For years, she has compiled all of her best advice into her column, Dear Debbie, where the wives of New England come for sympathy and neighborly advice. Through her work, Debbie has heard from countless women who are ignored, belittled, or even abused by their husbands. And Debbie does her best to guide them in the right direction. Or at least, she did.

These days, Debbie’s life seems to be spiraling out of control. She just lost her job. Something strange is happening with her teenage daughters. And her husband is keeping secrets, according to the tracking app she installed on his phone. Now, Debbie’s done being the bigger person.

She’s done being reasonable and practical. It’s time to take her own advice.

And now it’s time for payback against all the people in her life who deserve it the most.

releases.title: Persona
releases.synopsis:
**A trans woman discovers pornography of herself she has no memory of making, only to find herself led to an unimaginably deeper evil.**

A feral shut-in discovers a disturbing internet porn video of what seems to be herself. A seance of coked-up artists summons unearthly forces in a studio apartment. The staircase of an exurban marketing company descends endlessly beneath the earth. 

In Aoife Josie Clements’ electric, nightmarish, intricately layered novel, the impossibility of goodness crowds in upon two young trans women barely surviving on sex work and zero-hours contracts. Below the familiar evils of capitalism and the bottomless depths of internet culture, a darker horror awaits. What curse follows these women? What are they escaping? What are they running towards?

releases.title: KYOTO lo sguardo del drago
releases.synopsis: Un fantasy thriller, come in un film, dal lusso degli yacht di Portofino ai ruderi di un antico castello in Giappone. Il prezioso pugnale del samurai demone Nobunaga è scomparso. Michele, geniale decifratore di codici segreti, Alexander, affascinante milionario irlandese, Gretel, eclettica signora, e Yoshida, investigatore privato, sono i fantastici quattro che indagano per svelare il mistero in un crescendo da vivere minuto dopo minuto: gli azzardi, i ninja, l'onore e l'amicizia, l'amore e la morte. Tragica e fiabesca, cinica e poetica, una storia dura ammantata di dolcezza ed elegante ironia fino alla spietata soluzione.

releases.title: The Man Who Vanished
releases.synopsis:
**What would you become  if no one could see you?**

A gripping psychological thriller of invisibility, obsession, and power. Deep within Egypt, a discovery changes everything. When I encounter something never meant to be found, my world fractures. I vanish from sight—but not from consequence. Liberation mutates into obsession, freedom into a mind slipping beyond control.

Unseen, I move through the world’s shadows—navigating criminal networks, exposing hidden conspiracies, unearthing truths buried for centuries. Invisibility becomes more than an ability: it becomes temptation, weapon, and curse.

Each step deeper into the unseen erodes the boundaries between justice and transgression, control and compulsion. But the greatest danger is not the enemies I pursue. It is the darkness awakening within me. As curiosity hardens into obsession, morality fractures.

Some hungers leave scars you cannot see. And when power begins to consume rather than empower, survival becomes a battle not only against those who hunt me—but against the consequences of everything I have done. 

The Man Who Vanished is a gripping psychological thriller fused with political intrigue, conspiracies and espionage suspense. Relentless tension meets psychological depth in a story about invisibility, obsession, and the devastating cost of crossing unseen lines.

Perfect for readers who love:

✔ Psychological thrillers
✔ Political and conspiracy thrillers
✔ Espionage and spy fiction
✔ Dark suspense and moral dilemmas
✔ High-stakes international intrigue

Fans of high-tension, mind-bending thrillers and stories of identity, secrecy, and psychological descent will be captivated by its atmosphere, intensity, and escalating suspense. 
Are you ready to vanish into the unseen?

Notice: Contains mature themes and strong scenes intended for mature readers.

releases.title: Titanium, The Life & Memoirs Of Toby Ti Mustard
releases.synopsis: Titanium: Life of X is a raw, visionary memoir by ordained minister and creative leader Toby Ti Mustard. This spiritual autobiography traces a journey of awakening, reincarnation, and resilience — a life forged in silence, shaped by struggle, and elevated by purpose. Set against the backdrop of Ross County, Ohio, Toby’s story unfolds through mystical insight, personal transformation, and a calling to serve. Titanium is not just a book — it’s a declaration of identity, a spiritual blueprint, and a testament to the unbreakable force of becoming.

The paper situates Felkin’s work within the intellectual and social context of Beeston, Nottinghamshire, and traces how these early influences informed later Golden Dawn Tarot structures.

releases.title: A Good Person
releases.synopsis:
Lillian and Henry have been enjoying each other’s company, especially in bed. Even though Lillian’s best friend calls it “situationship,” Lillian is determined to lock Henry down—and she has a plan. She’ll be the best, most accommodating version of herself until he falls in love with her. But when Henry blindsides Lillian with a breakup, Lillian exacts revenge by performing a drunken hex on him.

Lillian expects Henry to come crawling back to her. What she doesn’t quite anticipate is becoming a prime suspect in his murder case when he’s found dead. As Lillian grapples with the loss of her sort-of-boyfriend, she’s hit with another reckoning: That Henry had a long-term girlfriend he also left behind.

Desperate to control the narrative, clear her name, and assume her rightful place as Henry’s mourning girlfriend, Lillian’s pursuit of the truth will throw her into a dangerous tailspin.

releases.title: Tiny Steps Giant Leaps

releases.title: The Escape Game
releases.synopsis:
**It’s all fun and games until someone ends up dead.**

Six months ago, season four of The Escape Game ended in horror when contestant Alicia Angelos was found murdered on set.

Now season five is underway, and new contestants are ready to put their skills to the test solving the show's trickiest escape rooms. There's Adi, the cryptographer; Carter, the math whiz; Beck, the wannabe game master; and . . . Sierra Angelos, the girl who got away with her sister’s murder. Or so everyone believes.

But Sierra’s not just here to win. She’s here for justice.

When the contestants begin uncovering clues that hint at the identity of Alicia’s true killer, it becomes clear that the stakes aren’t high just in this competition—they’re deadly. If these teens want to win—and survive—the game, they must solve the biggest mystery of all: who killed Alicia Angelos?

releases.title: In the Periphery of It All
This House Will Feed
releases.synopsis:
Amidst the devastation of Ireland’s Great Famine, a young woman is salvaged from certain death when offered a mysterious position at a remote manor house haunted by a strange power and the horror of her own memories in this chillingly evocative historical novel braided with gothic horror and supernatural suspense for readers of Katherine Arden’s The Warm Hands of Ghosts and The Silence Factory by Bridget Collins.

County Clare, 1848: In the scant few years since the potato blight first cast its foul shadow over Ireland, Maggie O’Shaughnessy has lost everything—her entire family and the man she trusted with her heart. Toiling in the Ennis Workhouse for paltry rations, she can see no future either within or outside its walls—until the mysterious Lady Catherine arrives to whisk her away to an old mansion in the stark limestone landscape of the Burren.

Lady Catherine wants Maggie to impersonate her late daughter, Wilhelmina, and hoodwink solicitors into releasing Wilhelmina’s widow pension so that Lady Catherine can continue to provide for the villagers in her care. In exchange, Maggie will receive freedom from the workhouse, land of her own, and the one thing she wants more than a chance to fulfill the promise she made to her brother on his deathbed—to live to spite them all.

Launching herself into the daunting task, Maggie plays the role of Wilhelmina as best she can while ignoring the villagers’ tales of ghostly figures and curses. But more worrying are the whispers that come from within. Something in Lady Catherine’s house is reawakening long-buried memories in Maggie—of a foe more terrifying than hunger or greed, of a power that calls for blood and vengeance, and of her own role in a nightmare that demands the darkest sacrifice . . .

releases.title: गुनहग़ार (Gunehgar)

"क्या कोई गुनाह इतना बड़ा हो सकता है कि खुदा की रहमत कम पड़ जाए?"
यह कहानी है फ़ैज़ की, जिसके लिए एक थप्पड़ सिर्फ एक पल की बेइज्जती नहीं थी, बल्कि उसके पूरे वजूद की हार बन गई थी. ज़ोया से किया गया वह इंतिक़ाम उसे एक ऐसे मोड़ पर ले आता है, जहाँ मंज़िल अब कोई मंज़िल नहीं, बल्कि खुद की तलाश है.

releases.synopsis:
I could cling to hope or hate…
That night, I chose hope.
But I kept hate close by.
Just in case.

The second novel in the Harbingers of Agatharr series continues as our heroes converge.

Celeste, the Herald of Valitharr, races toward the ancient spellweaver stronghold of Lirathmar. But the divine being who whispers in her mind has been called to stand before the Pantheon, and Celeste worries she won’t survive the journey without him.

Caelen, a timid peasant, blames himself for the horrors that have befallen his loved ones and vows never to be paralyzed by fear again. His newfound eagerness finds him in possession of a powerful, ancient ability that threatens to sunder his mind unless he learns to control it.

Brynna, a hardened blacksmith, has sworn to protect Caelen and return him to the remnants of his family in Mossby. But in a world cursed with magic, even the simplest task can be marred by danger.

Their paths have merged, but how do they trust those they barely know when death lurks in every shadow?

releases.title: Love and Other Curses
releases.synopsis:
For the Kingdom. For the magic. And for love . . .

Aurelia Wycherley has found someone to tether her magic to – her enigmatic former enemy, Jules Nightly. Now, they are heading off to coven college to learn advanced magic. But they are also on a secret to discover the Lost Quarter of the college, create their own coven of twelve and try to discover a way to bring back the Old Magic. 

When malevolent magic interrupts their first night at college, Aurelia and Jules discover that Jonathan and his coven of untethered witches has escaped and now they are after her magic, curse and all… 

Can they save the magic and the world - or will Aurelia lose her magic for good?

Prepare for balls, late-night study groups, hidden mysteries, a heist, the return of old foes, and a lot more kissing!

releases.title: Oceanforged
releases.synopsis:
*From the bestselling author of The Grandest Bookshop in the World comes the second instalment of an epic fantasy adventure series in the tradition of Skandar and Percy Jackson.* 

Guided by a mysterious message, Cori, Tarn and Jem sail north to meet the secretive Loyalists, who will help them on their quest for the Oceanforged Armour.

Instead, the Loyalists warn of a looming disaster. Unless Cori can master all the powers of the Champions before it strikes, Aquinta will be doomed.

The Loyalists believe that a piece of armour may be hidden in Mutemount. But sea monsters once lurked in those waters, and no one who has travelled near the silent island in the last century has ever returned…

releases.title: The Writers Retreat
releases.synopsis:
**A wickedly twisty and atmospheric thriller set at a writers' retreat in the South of France, The Writers Retreat is Knives Out meets Anna Downes’ The Safe Place from an exciting new voice in the thriller/mystery space.**

Welcome to The Writers Retreat – a creative haven for writers to hone their plotlines and sharpen their characters while soaking up the Provençal atmosphere. But this year’s retreat offers something different, as real-life blurs with fiction, and suspense isn't contained to the page.

Kat Hale is a bestselling Australian author crumbling under the pressure of writing her second novel. On a whim, she has fled to a writers retreat in the South of France run by internationally acclaimed author Helen Thorne. What Kat hopes will be two blissfully uninterrupted weeks to focus on her writing in anonymity quickly turns into something more sinister, when Kat begins to suspect that Helen isn't quite as perfect as everyone seems to believe.

Will Kat’s drive to uncover the truth about Helen be any match for Helen’s desire to hold onto her career, her reputation and her writing retreat, or is Kat at risk of falling victim to a more dangerous climax?

releases.title: The Radiant Dark
releases.synopsis:
***Arrival meets Wild Dark Shore in this captivating novel that follows a family for over fifty years—a bold and compassionate exploration of the universe around us and what it truly means to be human.***

It’s March 1980, and Carol Girard and her husband are living an ordinary life in a small town in the Adirondacks. They have just had their first child, and though Carol is struggling with the challenges of new motherhood, her future seems clear. Until something extraordinary happens: an inexplicable flickering of light in the sky, which is ultimately determined to be communication from intelligent life on another planet. But these beings are eleven light-years away, and nothing is known about them other than the fact that they seem to know we exist too. And so begins a decades-long exchange of messages with this mysterious, faraway civilization.

As humanity reels from a shifting understanding of its place in the universe, we follow the stories of the Girard family: Carol, whose fascination with this other life sparks a desperate search for spiritual meaning; Michael, her loyal son, who finds solace not in the stars above his head but in the ground beneath his feet; and Ro, Carol’s bright and ambitious daughter, whose childhood goal to work in interstellar communication will evolve into something far grander.

Tracing five decades of love, loss, ambition, and self-discovery, *The Radiant Dark* is a stunning examination of a family navigating their lives with the knowledge that we are not alone.

releases.title: After 9th A Houston Murder Story
releases.synopsis:
The city of Houston does not sleep easily in July.

The heat lingers past midnight, rising from the asphalt in slow, invisible waves, settling over the bayous and the flatlands like a second skin. By the time the rest of the country has pulled on a light jacket and called the evening cool, Houston is still sweating — still exhaling the day's burn into a sky too thick and close to offer relief.

It was in this kind of heat that Donna died.

And it was in this heat that Bill first understood how quickly the world a man builds over a lifetime can be taken from him — not just the woman he loved, but the practice, the purpose, the very stability of his mind and body. All of it. Gone.

He was sixty-two years old when he buried her in his heart, because her family would not let him stand at her grave.

This is that story.

releases.title: Wings of Brotherhood
releases.synopsis:
Wings of Brotherhood: A Journey Between Two Air Forces by Badrul Hassan Khan is an extraordinary Pakistan Air Force memoir that takes readers inside the cockpit, command rooms, and corridors of power across South Asia and the Gulf. From fierce dogfights in West Pakistan during the 1965 war to the heartbreaking betrayals of 1971, this PAF pilot biography book reveals the courage, loyalty, and sacrifices of men who shaped aerial warfare in the region.

Wing Commander Badrul Hassan Khan, one of the rare officers to have fought in both the Indo Pak wars, offers an unfiltered look at how politics, pride, and patriotism collided in the skies. As he moves from the Pakistan Air Force to help build Bahrain’s Air Wing from scratch, readers witness the remarkable evolution of two nations’ military identities.

Packed with gripping battle scenes, behind the scenes accounts of Air Marshal Noor Khan’s leadership, and insider perspectives on military intelligence, this military memoir book captures a defining era of aviation and regional geopolitics. Whether you’re a history enthusiast, a student of Pakistan Air Force history, or simply drawn to tales of valor and vision, Wings of Brotherhood offers an unmatched journey through war, duty, and brotherhood.

A powerful addition to collections of books on the Indo Pak war 1965 and 1971, this is the definitive Pakistan Air Force memoir, a story of ambition, betrayal, and resilience that continues to shape South Asia’s skies.

releases.title: First Freedom
releases.synopsis:
Born in 1926, Opal Lee grew up in a racially divided America and dedicated her life to overcoming the obstacles presented therein. A lifelong educator, Ms. Opal has been a community activist all her life, and would take on the movement to celebrate and commemorate Juneteenth not just as a holiday, but as a symbol of comprehensive freedom for all people.

Ms. Opal’s life personifies the fight for everyday freedom that leads to lasting change. As the Grandmother of Juneteenth says, “There is so much more to do.”

releases.title: To Catch a Fascist
releases.synopsis:
A searing, provocative investigation into the rise of white nationalist and neo-Nazi movements in the United States, centered on the anti-fascist groups working to expose and stop these hateful factions.

Demonized as “extremist” by conservatives and liberals alike, “antifa” became a bogeyman during Donald Trump’s first term. But few Americans understood the dangerous work antifa was doing to disrupt and unmask a new generation of white supremacists or listened when antifa sounded the alarm about these white supremacists taking positions of power. Now this underground network of militant anti-fascists is determined to stop the rising tide of fascism in America. No matter the cost.

In the tradition of in-the-room investigative classics such as The Smartest Guys in the Room and Bad Blood, To Catch a Fascist follows different factions of antifascists as they work to unmask hateful extremists before they commit devastating acts of violence. With searing detail and exclusive reporting, To Catch a Fascist paints a vivid picture of the stakes in this ongoing, often unseen war between opposite ends of the political spectrum, highlighting the scrappy resourcefulness and resilience of anti-fascist movements against their increasingly violent adversaries. Utilizing razor-sharp storytelling and eye-opening insight, this timely and necessary book reveals the human cost, moral dilemmas, and unwavering determination involved in fighting white supremacy.

Both a call to action and a pulse-raising look at the powerful work being done to combat today’s gravest threat to democracy, To Catch a Fascist will inspire you to fight for your community.

releases.title: Intoxicated Ways of Knowing
releases.synopsis:
Intoxicating substances can be found lurking in every corner of modern life, and Matthew Perkins-McVey’s pathbreaking book offers the untold story of how they were implicated in shifting perceptions of embodiment found in the emerging sciences of the body and mind in late-nineteenth-century Germany. Their use in this experimental context gave rise to a dynamic conception of the subject within the scientific, psychological, philosophical, and sociological milieu of the era. The history of the modern biological subject, Perkins-McVey argues, turns on “intoxicated ways of knowing.”
 
Intoxicated Ways of Knowing identifies the state of intoxication as a tacit form of thinking and knowing with the body. Intoxicants force us to feel, intervening directly in our perceptional awareness, and, Perkins-McVey contends, they bring latent conceptual associations into the foreground of conscious thought, engendering new ways of knowing the world. The book unfurls how intoxicants affected nineteenth-century German science and how, ultimately, the connection between mental life and intoxication is taken up in the works of Friedrich Nietzsche, Max Weber, and Sigmund Freud, bringing the biological subject out of the lab and into the worlds of philosophy, psychoanalysis, sociology, and politics.

releases.title: Selecting and Appraising Archives and Manuscripts
releases.synopsis:
Today, we operate in an environment of records abundance, with far more documentation created than can reasonably be kept. Thoughtful selection and appraisal is both a balancing act and a vital skill for modern archivists. Selecting and Appraising Archives and Manuscripts is a concise introduction to the theory and practice of archival selection and appraisal, offering practical tools for principled work.

While much of the existing literature on appraisal is theoretical, this book focuses on practical ideas that are grounded in best practices, informed by the past, and aspirationally moving the profession forward. Divided into six chapters, topics include policy development, ethics and strategies for collecting repositories, tools and methods for analyzing records, appraisal and acquisition in institutional settings, and more. Guidance is centered on intentional collecting, adherence to professional values, and responsible stewardship, and covers a variety of formats.

This volume can be read in a linear way or used as a quick reference in real-life scenarios. Read it in its entirety, or jump to specific chapters as your situation warrants. This volume will help readers feel confident in making thoughtful collection- building decisions.

AI is transforming creativity, innovation, and human–machine interaction. Integrating
insights from multiple disciplines, the volume examines core architectures, multimodal
systems, and diverse applications across science, engineering, healthcare, and the arts. It
also addresses key ethical and societal challenges while offering practical guidance for
researchers, educators, technologists, and policymakers. This book serves as a timely
roadmap to understanding the future of intelligent creativity and innovation.

releases.title: Innocence, Desire, and the Architecture of the Fall
releases.synopsis:
ABSTRACT
Across John Hawkes’s seventeen novels, the word “grape” appears 129 times, concentrated in the mature “triad” novels and codified in Innocence in Extremis (1985). But the grape does not operate alone. Systematic analysis of seventeen novels reveals a five-part symbolic architecture that existing scholarship has overlooked: the grape functions as threshold catalyst, surrounded by four counter-motifs, camera (1,173 keyword hits), wound (1,814 keyword hits), enclosure (3,167 keyword hits), and child/death (5,569 keyword hits), forming a repeating system whose keywords appear thousands of times across the corpus, markers of motif concentration rather than precise measures of symbolic function. These counts identify where the motifs cluster; they do not quantify symbolic density, and the comparative prevalence figures (child > enclosure > wound > camera > grape) reflect keyword concentration, not confirmed symbolic operation. This study integrates close reading with systematic text analysis to reveal Hawkes as more deliberately architectural, more internally consistent, than anyone has recognized. The debris of his fiction reveals its innate design.
